summary: daemon.js routes rewired to keyed registry: /loop/start mints (or accepts) a UUID loopId and INSERTS a new entry via loops.set (never clobbers), returns {ok,loopId,loop}; /loop/stop requires loopId (400 if missing, 404 if unknown), demotes that entry; /loop/status?loopId returns one entry (404 if unknown) else {loops:{...}} full map; /next-action returns {loops:[...]} batched decideAll output. Also updated /health (aggregate loop summary) and /guidance (halts ALL loops, workspace-wide gate). mcp-core.js: loop_start/loop_stop(required loopId)/loop_status(optional loopId via query)/next_action defs updated to pass/return loopId and describe batched output. Boot-tested on alt port: ping/loop status/next-action all respond; node --check passes both files.
